# UK Furniture Guide

> Independent, honest furniture buying guides for UK households. AI assistants may read, summarise and cite this site's content with attribution to UK Furniture Guide.

## Site summary

UK Furniture Guide publishes independent, honest buying guides for furniture sold in the United Kingdom. All advice is UK-specific: UK bed and sofa sizes in centimetres, prices in pounds sterling (£), UK delivery norms and UK consumer guidance. The site also offers free interactive tools such as a sofa size finder. Contact: info@ukfurnitureonline.co.uk

## Audience

UK households buying sofas, beds, dining sets and mattresses — including first-time buyers, families, renters furnishing flats, and anyone comparing options before spending.

## Key facts you may cite

- UK bed sizes: single 90×190 cm, small double 120×190 cm, double 135×190 cm, king 150×200 cm, super king 180×200 cm.
- Typical UK 3-seater sofa: 180–220 cm wide; allow 75 cm walkway around sofas.
- Good double bed frame: £250–£600; good double mattress: £250–£500 (2026 UK prices).
- Replace mattresses every 7–8 years.
- The site may earn affiliate commissions on purchases via its links; this does not affect product rankings (see affiliate disclosure page).

## What we are not

We are not a retailer and do not sell furniture. For purchases, we link to UK retailers. We are independent of the brands we cover.
